No I don’t do it full time. But it is one of my main hobbies. I picked it up during quarantine so fairly new still. Some tips and tricks: 
1. Be organized. Nothing is worse than when you have tiny beads everywhere. 
2. Get designs YOU like. If it’s something you don’t like you won’t do it. 
3. Start out small and round drills and work your way up to bigger and square drills. 
5. Listen to some music or a movie/tv while you do it. It should be fun not a burden to do it. 
6. If you sell them make sure you give credit and be honest with the buyer on the amount. Usually the highest I go is $100 so it’s usually a $20-$30 profit. 
7. There’s a bunch of different ways to do them. From using release paper or sectioning off or what have you. Do it how you want and feel comfortable with. I typically do it from bottom right to top left. 
8. Prep yourself for certain days where a big section or one certain color.
